keyword: has a 16 seed ever beaten a 1 seed
claims: A 16-seed has beaten a 1-seed in the men's NCAA tournament twice in history.
In 2018, UMBC (University of Maryland, Baltimore County) beat the top-seeded Virginia Cavaliers 74–54.
In 2023, Fairleigh Dickinson (FDU) beat the top-seeded Purdue Boilermakers 63–58.
